results.main: The frozen integration is technically valid but does not robustly improve recovery. Original MODIFY remains: E009 +0.2357 percentage points / +1,307,506 bp / >=90% targets 7 to 8; oral -0.8389 points / -17,474,841 bp / 33 to 27. Neither endpoint meets +0.5 points and oral violates no-loss/count gates. Do not promote E020 or choose a pipeline/refiner per community.
results.grouping: Both learned spaces are exactly E019. Original E017 information grouping moves much more eligible DNA to unassigned: post E009 2.944 to 60.875 Mb, oral 10.026 to 402.581 Mb. B3 F1 falls 48.5636 to 44.8539% / 30.6625 to 26.5985%, despite some recovery/count gains. In oral the core-only parent is already weak at 1.9600%; recruiting raises R95 to 2.1791% with 22 gains / 5 losses. Thus short rejection alone is not a demonstrated complete explanation; core mixing/fragmentation and recruitment trade-offs remain.
results.marker: Fixed E013 rescues oral parent 2.1791 to 5.6688%: +72,694,094 bp, 26 targets gain / none lose. Old to E013 has 17 gains / 4 losses but +42,597,219 bp. E009 selected and parent recoveries match for every target, although assignments differ; old refiner 7.8750% has fewer >=90% targets than post 7.5416%, 7 versus 8. Do not select old proposals with truth.
